reviewed_by: Claude review of chat resume callbacks
reason: Five verified defects from the provider chat audit. (1) ChatService._resume_pending_call never checked the receipt for results_url/results_api_key the way _stream_tool_turn does, so an approved background run_command was recorded as complete, the turn routed again with no output, and the later results webhook found no WAITING_CALLBACK turn (continue_after_tool_callback returned None). Both paths now classify results through one helper, _tool_result_entry, and the resume parks the turn in WAITING_CALLBACK, yields callback_required and releases the claim; _stream_tool_turn returns after a resume that ends in WAITING_CALLBACK instead of re-announcing the wait. (2) _produce_provider_turn stored the producer's CancelledError in runtime.error and follow_provider_turn re-raised it inside every follower's own task, closing the SSE body with no terminal frame and logging an operator stop as a client disconnect. The cancel branch now appends a terminal cancelled event ('response stopped'); runtime.error is reserved for real failures and the durable status reconciliation is unchanged. (3) BedrockProvider reported only type(exc).__name__; a botocore ClientError now surfaces Error.Code: Error.Message, whitespace-collapsed, passed through redact_text and bounded, while other exceptions keep the type name. (4) MissionRuntime._dispatch nulled a SpecialistApprovalRequired card when compaction spend tripped the token or cost budget, leaving the persisted Approval PENDING forever; it is now cancelled with decision_note 'mission budget exhausted' before being dropped. (5) _refresh_context_metadata wrote the profile with the revision read before a 15 s provider call, so a concurrent profile save escaped as ConflictError and failed the turn with a raw revision message; the refreshed descriptor is now merged onto the current revision after the call and retried once on conflict. Tests, each failing on main: test_approved_background_command_waits_for_its_callback drives a real AutomationBroker through approval, resume, WAITING_CALLBACK and the results webhook; test_stopping_provider_chat_ends_followers_with_a_cancelled_event; test_bedrock_reports_the_client_error_code_and_message; test_budget_overrun_cancels_the_approval_it_drops; test_context_metadata_refresh_merges_onto_a_concurrent_profile_save. test_chat_tool_loop.py covers the fresh tool path moved onto the shared helper, test_chat.py the context-recovery callers, test_chat_api.py the other follower contracts, test_providers.py the remaining adapters.
exclusions: No frontend tests: no ui/ change (the UI chat stream parser ignores unrecognised wire types, so the new cancelled frame is a no-op there). No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:core-api (the real-Core journey suite matched through chat.py and providers.py) does not approve a background command, stop a followed turn or use Bedrock; the Python tests drive these paths directly. tests/v3/test_orchestration.py is selected by node id: test_mission_compacts_only_model_facing_dependency_context_and_charges_usage and test_mission_rejects_compaction_before_call_when_budget_is_insufficient are excluded because they fail on pristine origin/main (verified at e000169 in this worktree before any change): their 600-token stub profile hits the COMPACTOR_MIN_OUTPUT_TOKENS capacity error before the budget check they assert, which is unrelated to this change. No full suites.
